series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Morty is welcomed by a family whose lost son he resembles, then pressured to destroy his way home.
Prior events (Part 2): Morty is forced into the woods to make him strong enough to stay, where he finds a journal and a possible path home.
Prior events (Part 3): Morty escapes the woods and tracks Rick to MIT, only to discover Rick locked away his multiverse research and gave up science for Alcoholics Anonymous.
Prior events (Part 4): Morty discovers Rick living a peaceful, sober life with his new wife who encourages him to help Morty return home, unaware that the foster mother from the woods has tracked Morty to Boston.
Prior events (Part 5): Professor Sanchez breaks his sobriety to build Morty a portal home, but the foster family ambushes them before a lethal test reveals the rift is deadly.
